content.user_title: Trace SpecDD Specs to Code and Tests
content.value_statement: SpecDD projects can lose clear links between specs, source files, tests, and documentation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to trace those links and report gaps without editing files by default.
actual_capabilities: Confirms that a project has a SpecDD bootstrap file before use.
Defines the bootstrap file order for root, project, and local context.
Guides agents to resolve spec chains for target paths, tasks, behavior, or changed files.
Connects specs to implementation files, tests, docs, and diffs.
Structures reports around constraints, coverage gaps, stale specs, and unclear authority.
Limits edits until the user asks and governing specs grant authority.
limitations: Only applies to projects that already contain .specdd/bootstrap.md.
Does not run tests, inspect coverage tools, or execute CLI commands by itself.
Depends on available specs and repository context for accurate trace results.
Does not grant write authority or make edits without explicit user direction.

use_cases.title: Review implementation coverage
use_cases.description: Trace a feature spec to code and tests so missing scenarios are visible before release.

use_cases.title: Audit changed files against specs
use_cases.description: Check whether a pull request follows the active SpecDD contracts for the touched files.

use_cases.title: Find documentation gaps
use_cases.description: Compare specs, docs, and behavior to identify stale or missing project guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a target path
prompt_templates.prompt: Trace the SpecDD spec chain for the target path I give you. Explain which specs apply and why each one matters.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner trace for one file, folder, or feature area.

prompt_templates.title: Connect specs to tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this behavior against its SpecDD specs. Tell me which tests cover it and which scenarios appear untested.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of test coverage against requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Review changed files
prompt_templates.prompt: Trace these changed files to their governing specs. Report matching constraints, possible stale specs, and unclear authority.
prompt_templates.scenario: Pull request or patch review for SpecDD compliance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a traceability report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SpecDD traceability report for this work. Include bootstrap sources, governing specs, implementation evidence, tests, docs, and gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit across specs, files, tests, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Trace the specs for a changed authentication feature.
output_examples.output: The report identifies the bootstrap source, the governing authentication spec, related tests, and one missing scenario for failed login handling.

output_examples.input: Check whether a documentation update follows SpecDD authority.
output_examples.output: The response explains which local spec grants authority, which referenced docs are read context, and where the requested edit needs confirmation.

output_examples.input: Find gaps between a feature spec and current tests.
output_examples.output: The trace links each behavior to existing test evidence and flags untested edge cases for follow-up.

best_practices: Start with the exact target path, behavior, or changed files that need tracing.
Provide relevant diffs or file names so the trace can stay narrow.
Ask for gaps, stale specs, and unclear authority when reviewing work.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill in projects without a SpecDD bootstrap file.
Do not treat referenced files as write authority unless a governing spec grants it.
Do not ask for broad repository scans when a focused target is enough.

faq.question: What is specdd-trace used for?
faq.answer: It helps trace SpecDD specs to code, tests, docs, changed files, and coverage gaps.

faq.question: Does it edit files?
faq.answer: No. The skill says not to edit files unless the user explicitly asks for changes.

faq.question: Can it be used outside SpecDD projects?
faq.answer: No. It applies only when the project already has a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.

faq.question: Does it run the SpecDD CLI?
faq.answer: No. It may suggest consulting related CLI context when available, but it does not execute commands by itself.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I provide in a prompt?
faq.answer: Provide a target path, behavior, changed files, or review goal so the trace can stay focused.
